# Chapter 1: The First Bell

Erian arrived at the Quiet Tower through the dawn fog.

The villagers had always said the tower was empty.

A single silver bell hung beside the door.

He touched the bell carefully.

A clear sound carried to the end of the valley.

A moment later, footsteps came from the floor above.

An old man was looking down from the stairs.

"I have waited a long time, young man."
